test_title: PYST 01: SSC Stenographer 2025: General Intelligence & Reasoning (Held On: 06 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Directions: Consider the following information and answer the question given below For the selection of a professor in a college, the following are the conditions to be satisfied.

A Candidate:

(a) must be a B.Sc graduate with a minimum of 60% marks

(b) minimum age should be of 22 years

(c) must have at least 50% marks in X class

(d) must have a diploma/degree/P.G degree.<br /&
solution:
The conditions for the selection of a professor in a college are as follows:

 
 

 S.No.
 Eligibility criteria
 Fulfillment
 
 

 (a)
 Must be a B.Sc graduate with a minimum of 60% marks
 Yes, Sahil is B.Sc. graduate with 66% marks.
 
 

 (b)
 Minimum age should be of 22 years
 Yes, Sahil is 26 years old. 
 
 

 (c)
 Must have at least 50% marks in X class
 Yes, Sahil scored 75%.
 
 

 (d)
 Must have a diploma/degree/P.G degree.
 Yes, Sahil is post graduate in M.Sc. with 60%.
 
 

 (e)
 Must have minimum 1 year work experience.
 Yes, Sahil has 1.5 years of work experience
 
 

 I.
 In case a Candidate satisfies all the above conditions, except (e) above, he must have 60% and above at X class and P.G degree
 Not applicable
 
 

 II.
 In case a Candidate satisfies all the above conditions, except (a) above, he must have minimum 2 years of work experience and will be selected as substitute teacher.
 Not applicable
 
 

 
 If any information is not known, then such case will be referred to Principal.
 Not applicable
 
 

Thus, Sahil Can be recruited as college professor

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
